name: Malawian Chambo with Nsima
description: Chambo, a real tilapia-family fish native to Lake Malawi, paired with nsima (stiff maize porridge), is widely considered Malawi's national dish - regular tilapia is a genuinely close match here, not just a stand-in, since chambo belongs to the same tilapia family. Real technique dredges the fish lightly before frying for a crisp crust, and the nsima is beaten hard while cooking to build its dense, smooth texture.
steps_detailed: Dredge the fish lightly in the flour with a pinch of salt.
Fry, 3-4 minutes per side, until golden and crisp.
Whisk about a third of the cornmeal with the remaining salt into 1.25 cups boiling water.
Gradually beat in the remaining cornmeal, stirring vigorously, over medium-low heat 15-18 minutes, until very thick and smooth.
Serve the nsima alongside the fried fish.

name: Malawian Ndiwo
description: Ndiwo, a vegetable relish served alongside nsima, real technique cooking the onion and tomato into a genuine base first before the greens go in, rather than boiling everything together at once.
steps_detailed: Cook the onion and garlic 4-5 minutes until softened.
Add the tomatoes and cook until it forms a thick base, 5-6 minutes.
Add the spinach and simmer 10-12 minutes until tender.

name: Malawian Nsima
description: Nsima, a stiff maize porridge, is Malawi's most essential staple, so central to daily life it's recognized by UNESCO as part of the country's intangible cultural heritage.
steps_detailed: Whisk about a third of the cornmeal with the salt into 1.25 cups boiling water.
Gradually beat in the remaining cornmeal, stirring vigorously, over medium-low heat 15-18 minutes, until very thick, smooth, and pulls away from the sides of the pot.

name: Malawian Dovi
description: Dovi, meat stewed in real ground peanut sauce, shared with Zimbabwe and common in Malawi as well, real versions whisked slowly to keep the sauce smooth.
steps_detailed: Brown the chicken, 6-7 minutes.
Whisk the peanut butter slowly with the tomatoes and a little water, add to the chicken.
Simmer 20-22 minutes until the chicken is tender.
